messages:
ana: Heads-up — after the proxy rekey in eu-west this morning we started seeing TLS handshake failures between internal proxies and sidecars. Not full outage but elevated 502s on some inter-service calls.

ana: Error in logs: `tls: handshake failure: remote error: tls: bad certificate`

ana: Anyone touched TLS profiles or CA bundles in the eu cluster?

sanjay: I rolled a new intermediate CA for infra certs last night but only targeted control-plane and vault. I did not touch proxy bundles.

lina: I pushed a change earlier that consolidated two `tls_profile` configs for our envoy shared layer (global -> regional override). Could be related.

mike-sre: Repro notes: failures appear when connecting to older dedicated nodes (older envoy image). Newer nodes (envoy 1.20) succeed. Looks like TLS version/cipher mismatch or SNI handling.

ana: Sample client hello log from failing sidecar (sanitized):
```
ClientHello: version=0x0304 (TLS1.3), cipher_suites=[0x1301,0x1302,0x1303], server_name=service-a.internal.eu-west
extensions: supported_versions, signature_algorithms, key_share
```
Server reply from older node shows `alert: protocol_version`
```
ServerHello: version=0x0303 (TLS1.2), cipher=0xc02f
```

tj: So the older envoy is negotiating TLS1.2 and prefers ECDHE-RSA while clients attempt TLS1.3-only suites. That would explain `protocol_version` alerts.

lina: I pushed a config that set `tls_min_version: TLSv1_3` at the region profile level. I assumed all proxies were on the newer image. My bad.

sanjay: We need three things: (1) immediate mitigation to restore connectivity, (2) a safe migration plan to TLS1.3 across all images, (3) audit + RBAC signoff for profile changes.

ana: For mitigation can we add a compatibility profile that allows TLS1.2 temporarily? e.g., set `min_version: TLSv1_2` and broaden cipher suites for region until we coordinate a rolling upgrade.

mike-sre: +1. I'll open a canary rollback for the profile change. If we push `min_version: TLSv1_2` to eu-west proxies only, that should restore at-risk traffic.

deploy-bot: deploy started: patch/tls-eu-compatibility -> rollout in eu-west (canary 3%)

cert-bot: Note: CA rotation completed 04:13 UTC. New intermediates signed for infra, but old intermediates still valid until next-month expiry.

lina: Apologies — I missed the image divergence. For the upgrade path, propose:
- inventory nodes by envoy image and region
- schedule envoys <1.20 for immediate upgrade (rolling)
- keep compat profile for 48 hours then flip to TLS1.3 only
- create A/B tests for high-qps routes first

tj: Also need to update KMS usage docs: our cert issuance pipeline (vault -> signing -> envoy) uses KMS-wrapped keys in different regions. Region eu uses separate KMS key which had a key-policy change last week. Confirming whether that impacted signature algorithms.

sanjay: I checked KMS access logs — no denies. Policies were tightened but service account had access. However the signing plugin defaulted to RSA-PSS for 1.20 images and older envoys expect RSA-PKCS1. That subtle alg mismatch might cause bad cert verify.

ana: Good catch. So we might need to ensure the signing endpoint can emit PKCS1 or we set envoy to accept PSS signatures during migration. Which is safer?

mike-sre: Safer to make proxies accept both during migration. Hard to change all signing behavior without risk. We should avoid forcing old nodes to validate a new alg they don't know.

lina: I'll open a PR to relax signature verification to accept PSS in the newest config, gated by a feature flag and audit log.

sanjay: RBAC question: who needs to approve the region tls_profile change? We have a policy that any global->region override requires two infra approvers + security signoff.

ana: Correct. We need infra (mike-sre + tj) and security (sanjay) approvals before we remove compatibility. Lina, do you have the PR link?

lina: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/patch/tls-profile-eu
Description: relax min_version during rollback + feature-flag for pss_accept
Changes include an audit header that logs who triggered the change.

mike-sre: I reviewed. LGTM for immediate rollback. I'll approve and kick off a controlled rollout.

sanjay: Security signoff: ok with temporary TLS1.2 fallback provided we log all connections and flag any foreign CA chains. Enable extra audit logging on proxy auth checks for the next 72h.

deploy-bot: rollout completed: patch/tls-eu-compatibility -> eu-west 100% (12 nodes) at 1833012345

ana: Monitoring: 502s dropped to baseline after rollout. Still seeing a handful of failed cert-chains from a legacy dev cluster.

tj: For follow-up tasks:
- inventory all clusters for envoy version and signature algorithm support (sanjay)
- update KMS signing plugin to default to PKCS1 but keep PSS as opt-in (infra)
- add automated pre-deploy check that fails region overrides if a quorum of nodes in region cannot support new tls_profile (lina)
- document RBAC approval flow for TLS profile edits (security)

sanjay: I'll start the inventory and post a CSV to #eng-infra when ready.

ana: Thanks everyone. Quick wins worked. Postmortem template: short blameless writeup + timeline + follow-up tasks. I'll draft and ping for approvals. :thumbsup:
